source.title: Mathematics in Hitler's Germany: Importance, results and open problems of a historical question

trace.notes: Input normalized as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/1210470. Shell fetching failed with network_or_dns_failure: curl could not resolve host zbmath.org or api.zbmath.org in the local sandbox. Direct web opening of the zbMATH URL and API record did not return a readable primary source artifact. Local project resolver metadata in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv identified the same URL as a 1998 source titled Mathematics in Hitler's Germany: Importance, results and open problems of a historical question, with no full-text links.

Bounded recovery searched the exact title, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus Gazette des Mathématiciens, the zbMATH identifier, and SMF Gazette issue-75/article URL patterns. Web citations identified the work as Reinhard Siegmund-Schultze, Gazette des Mathématiciens 75 (Janvier 1998), pages 35-41, but the inspected candidates were secondary citations, general background pages, SMF catalogue or issue pages, unrelated PDFs, or non-confirmed guessed PDF endpoints. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML page containing the article text or problem statements could be verified, so extraction from metadata, snippets, or secondary citations was rejected.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-1210470.json and mirrored it to outputs/latest.json.
